items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: After he left my band, he went a little while with Fletcher when Fletcher was on the road.

ctx.x: I don't know, Dick, but I assume that he is. After he left my band, he went a little while with Fletcher when Fletcher was on the road. He was always a fickle fellow, wanting a gold, gold, gold, so I imagine he just kept running. And I never heard from him, he's one of the characters that never did Carl Strawn much.
Yeah. But what did he do when the moon changed? Can you tell me?
